info.name: BMP Compliance Platform API
info.description:
Tests every endpoint of the BMP Compliance Platform API.

**Run order:** use the Collection Runner on the whole collection (folders 00-13 are in dependency order), or run `01 > Login as administrator` first and then any single request.

**Environment:** import `BMP_Compliance_Platform.postman_environment.json` and set the three passwords to the one you gave `python scripts/manage_users.py init-demo`.

**Data:** assumes the seeded demo data (company 2 = BrightMed, company 1 = Nexatech). It creates test records; nothing is ever deleted.

Every request has test scripts, so a green run proves the API works.

exec: // Every change must carry the CSRF token returned by login.

request.description: No sign-in needed. Use it for monitoring.
Run this before logging in (or after logging out) to see the protection.
Counts towards the lock-out (5 failures in 10 minutes). Run it once.

Signs in. The test script stores the returned CSRF token in the collection variable `csrf`; the collection's pre-request script then sends it as the `X-CSRF-Token` header on every change. The session cookie is kept by Postman's cookie jar.
